description: Extract business-travel expense fields from a receipt. Application identifiers, image URLs and timestamps are supplied by the application, not extracted or invented.

merchant.description: Name of the merchant, restaurant, hotel or service provider.

category.description: Expense category: food, hotel, flight, ground transport, or other.

date.description: Receipt transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave absent when not printed; do not invent a date.

totalAmount.description: Final total paid, including taxes and tips, in the receipt currency.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code when identifiable from the receipt.

lineItems.description: Purchased items or services, excluding duplicate subtotal and grand-total rows.

description.description: Description of the purchased item or service.

category.description: Item category: food, drink, hotel, flight, ground transport, or other.

price.description: Price paid for this receipt line item, in the receipt currency.

quantity.description: Quantity purchased, when stated on the receipt.

notes.description: Relevant receipt details or extraction uncertainties. Do not invent identifiers, dates, timestamps or image URLs.
